tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: All CANOPY locations: name, neighborhood, address, whether it is open or opening soon, the memberships offered there with starting prices, and how tours are booked. No contact details needed.

tools.name: get_location
tools.description: Everything published about one location: address, transit, amenities, photos, memberships and that location's own starting prices, the meeting-room booking link, and how tours are booked. Use a location_id from list_locations.

tools.name: get_membership_options
tools.description: CANOPY's memberships (Private Office, Personal Desk, Community Table, Hybrid, Nomad, Virtual Office, Team Suites): what each includes, its starting price and where it is offered. Without a location_id the price is the lowest across locations; with one, it is that location's price.

tools.name: get_tour_slots
tools.description: Open tour times at one location from CANOPY's live tour calendar, in Pacific time. tour_type is in_person (default), virtual or test_drive. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; the default is the next 7 days, at most 21. If no times are open, the answer lists the alternatives in order: that location's virtual tour

tools.description: Checks one capability against CANOPY's published facts, overall or at one location: e.g. 24/7 access, private VLAN, wired internet, parking, boardroom, event space, phone booths, dogs, showers, team size.
